“And the Karpathos Device,” you ask, “was it returned to the 
museum?” He shakes his head. “Oh, no. It was scheduled to be 
sent to the National Museum in Cairo for a special exhibit. The 
Device may be Egyptian, you see. The plans were not changed.” 
If it is September, go to 128. If it is October, or later, go to 174.
